about.kind: DESK model on SIMULATED torques; nothing measured; not a decision
about.criteria_fixed: 27 Nov 2026 by the lead, before scoring (the study brief)
about.torque_rule: k = (m / 12.751 kg) x (S / 0.60 m); walk at min(0.25, 0.25 sqrt(S / 0.60)) m/s; no layout term; checked in simulation (S2) only for D0 as built and in L1

X4-36-L.src: sim/data/drives.json:4-10 (maker figures via the repo catalog, 7 Nov 2026); eq 7.5 N m = the 83 rpm 90-min equilibrium; Kt/R rl/analytics/results/fore128-s0/gait_report.json 'drives'; price myactuator.us 18 Nov 2026 (DECISION_LOG.md:53 F9); 83 rpm cap DECISION_LOG.md:36 E1, confirmed from the maker's V4.1 sheet read 28 Nov 2026 (study actuator fact sheet)

X6-60.src: sim/data/drives.json:12-20; eq 12 N m = the X6-50-L's 0 rpm table (no V4 table), 9 N m at its 153 rpm rated speed (MyActuator V4.1 X6-50-L sheet read 28 Nov 2026); Kt/R gait_report.json; price myactuator.us 18 Nov 2026 (F9)

X8-150.src: sim/data/drives.json:21-29 (eq 34 / 38 / 36 / 20 N m at 0 / 10 / 30 / 127 rpm; 34 used, as the build's file); Kt 2.97 N m/A rms and 0.180 ohm line (0.090 per phase): MyActuator V4.1 spec book read 28 Nov 2026 (study actuator fact sheet, 'Electrical constants'); price myactuator.us 18 Nov 2026 (F9)

RS03.src: RobStride maker README (github.com/RobStride/Product_Information README_main.md:20, read 28 Nov 2026): '21 N m @ 100 rpm | 60 N m', 900 g +-20 g; third-party extracts of the manual (scratch facts_actuators.md:151, :231; RS03_huphy.txt:151, :171): the aluminium heat-sink condition, 13 N m held still (used here as eq: NOT an open-air equilibrium, so not comparable with MyActuator's tables), Kt 2.36 N m/A rms, 880 g +-20 g; resistance NOT FOUND: 0.293 ohm is a DESK assumption giving the X6-50-L's copper loss at equilibrium (26.7 W); 106 x 56 mm, 0.90 kg; $225 Seeed (datasheet page updated 21 Oct 2026, hardware/triceratops_kickoff/PARTS_PREMIUM.md:217); no US stock confirmed, so 41.5 % duty in every scenario (DECISION_LOG.md E4)

known_clash_labels.8: tail pitch servo into the tail yaw servo

config_notes.C3: value = the model's clamp (0.70 x maker peak), which every stored and probed simulated peak sits at, x k, over the new drive's maker peak; supporting_need_worst = the same x the lowest force-limit factor at which the 60 cm walkers still walked and took 0.5 m/s pushes (not the criterion)
config_notes.mass: per class in the full run (form_factor_study.mass_model); summary here
config_notes.C7: continuous only here (and the hind knee's peak at the clamp); peaks in published_c7 and in the full run
config_notes.C4: pass = C4 as written; pass_except_9_and_11_changed_after_a_result = the supporting reading; known_clashes n: [least distance m, removed]; axle end: [bending at the static rod case on the model's 12.8 mm axle MPa, solid diameter for SF 2.0 on 580 MPa m, thigh twisting moment N m]; the layout draws each axle at the larger of 12.8 mm and that diameter (revised after the third review, R3-1); left_right_least_m 1.0 = no pair within 30 mm (not measured closer)
config_notes.limits: limits and margins are the pre-registered lines (C1 90 C, C2 and C3 0.80, C4 5 mm, C5 30 min) and are not repeated per configuration

known_clash_notes.1 (L2): removed by the layout: the knee drive sits at the hip, bolted to the thigh's root plate
known_clash_notes.11: not modelled here (the record's fix: a clevis)
known_clash_notes.12: removed by construction: each knee axle runs through its output crank's hub
